author: Nelev
body:
## Summary

Since #55, an upload writes turns to the conversation. That meant a message sent while an upload was still running raced it: before the first message, the two each started their own conversation.

- The send button is disabled while `isUploadingDocument` is true, the same way it already is while a message is in flight.
- The submit handler also returns early during an upload, so pressing Enter in the message field can't send either.

This fixes the first known limitation listed in #55.

## Test plan

- [x] `yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn tsc --noEmit && yarn test` (38 passed). A new composer test checks that during an upload the button is disabled and Enter sends nothing, and that sending works again once the upload finishes.
- [ ] Manual: start an upload and check the send button stays disabled until the reply appears
